reviewItem.question: Does "Storage version of `externalsecrets.external-secrets.io` changes v1beta1 → v1" mean a change to gvk:external-secrets|group=external-secrets.io|version=v1beta1|kind=ExternalSecret (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: The storage version of the externalsecrets.external-secrets.io CRD changed from v1beta1 to v1 in external-secrets 0.16.0 (v1beta1 storage: true → false), so existing ExternalSecret objects remain stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, and a storage version migration plus a status.storedVersions update must be completed before a later release removes v1beta1.
